facts.activity_file: charging, tying in and guarding a blast

control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: near hit - kinetic exposure at MAG-9601

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 5 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on MAG-9601 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in charging and firing, specifically charging, tying in and guarding a blast. MAG-9601 (explosives magazines) is in service for explosives and detonator storage. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 21 November 2009 a near hit was recorded on MAG-9601 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
